categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in high-performance composite materials, focusing on ePTFE microporous products, CMD and gas management products, SiO2 aerogel products, and high-performance wiring harness products. It also maintains traditional businesses including water-blocking membranes, sealing parts, and sound absorption products, mainly serving automotive, consumer electronics, aerospace, and medical sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include ePTFE membrane manufacturing, modification, and composite technologies, CMD technology for condensation management, and SiO2 aerogel composite materials. The company independently designs and manufactures production equipment and applies advanced material modification and composite techniques. Production is mainly self-operated with some outsourcing for simpler processes, emphasizing automation and intelligent manufacturing upgrades.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are automotive OEMs and parts manufacturers, consumer electronics companies, aerospace firms, and medical device manufacturers. The company serves domestic and international markets, with a strong presence in China and exports to overseas markets. Major clients include well-known automotive lighting companies and large automotive groups.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and main production facilities in Jiangsu Province. It also exports products internationally, with overseas sales accounting for a smaller but growing portion of revenue. The company’s subsidiaries and investments are located in Shanghai and Jiangsu.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream of the supply chain, producing advanced materials and components such as ePTFE membranes and composite products that are supplied to downstream manufacturers in automotive, electronics, aerospace, and medical industries. It controls the full production process from raw material processing to finished components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic focus is on continuous innovation in ePTFE membranes, aerogel composites, and gas management technologies, expanding into new niche markets like automotive wiring harnesses, medical devices, and aerospace applications. The company emphasizes R&D investment, talent acquisition, industry-academia collaboration, and intelligent manufacturing to enhance product performance and cost competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-performance composite materials and components to industrial customers, mainly via direct sales channels supplemented by distributors. The company also earns income from licensing proprietary technologies and providing technical support services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the few domestic enterprises mastering the full ePTFE membrane production chain, competing with international giants like W.L. Gore & Associates and Nitto Denko. It holds a leading position in China’s high-performance composite materials market, actively promoting import substitution and industry standards development.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 514.78 million, a 25.39% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 99.16 million, up 14.58%. Total assets reached RMB 1.09 billion, with steady growth in cash flow from operations and R&D investment accounting for 5.56% of revenue. The company maintains a stable and growing financial profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly customized, high-performance ePTFE membranes and composite materials with superior chemical stability, mechanical properties, and multifunctionality. Its proprietary CMD technology provides cost-effective, environmentally friendly condensation management solutions. The integration of advanced materials like aerogels and the ability to design and produce specialized equipment create strong technical barriers and differentiated products that meet diverse customer needs.
